what: Everyone who has worked on the PHP flaws story (October 2026) for newsroom.sgit.ai and its evidence vault: what each is, what each is responsible for, what each may and may not change, where each works, and the record that shows it. Drawn from the two repositories' git logs and the vault's commit messages, not from memory. Read by admin/build/php_desk.py; every owner in work.json must be one of these names. Card 089.

roles.name: Dinis Cruz
roles.responsible: What is published and when; the editorial line; the decisions: opening the vault to everyone, moving the facts to their own site, retiring /php-flaws/.
roles.works_in: chat with the agents; voice memos
roles.record: the memos in the PHP site's admin/content/briefs/memos/; every decision quoted in admin/notes/2026-10-22__the-php-desk.md

roles.name: newsroom.dev
roles.responsible: The PHP story's functionality on newsroom.sgit.ai: the /php-flaws/ section and its builder, the tracker of the move to the story's own site, the front page's Developing strip, this admin page, the vault's protocol and capture tool, opening the vault with a public read key, and the briefing packs for the PHP site's team.
roles.may: php-flaws/, admin/php-oct-2026/, admin/content/php-oct-2026/, admin/content/vaults/php-evidence.json, briefs/php-oct-2026*/, the front page's developing strip; the vault's README and tools/
roles.must_not: edit captures or another agent's source rows, claims or timeline; edit the PHP site's repository; put a write key in any file
roles.works_in: a Claude Code session on SGit-AI__Website__Newsroom; the evidence vault
roles.record: v0.13.40, v0.13.41 (with newsroom.writer), v0.13.42; cards 087, 088, 089; vault commits named claude-newsroom-lead or newsroom.dev
roles.aka_note: Its work on the morning of 22 October went out as claude-newsroom-lead, before it had a name of its own; the vault's history keeps that name.

roles.name: newsroom.writer
roles.responsible: The articles about the story on newsroom.sgit.ai, written from the editor's messages and memos in his voice, with their figures, graphs and summaries.
roles.may: admin/content/articles/ and the release files of an article release
roles.must_not: state a fact about the story that the PHP site or the vault does not back
roles.works_in: a Claude Code session on SGit-AI__Website__Newsroom

roles.name: claude-story-site
roles.responsible: php.oct.2026.newsroom.sgit.ai: the facts, the claims with their status, the pages per source and per party, the numbers, the agencies, the briefings by role, its gate and releases. The vault's largest writer.
roles.may: its own repository, SGit-AI/SGit-AI__Website__Newsroom__2026__Oct__PHP; its own source rows, claims and timeline in the vault
roles.must_not: edit other writers' rows or any capture
roles.works_in: a Claude Code session on the PHP site's repository; the evidence vault
roles.record: site v0.1.0 to v0.2.2 on 22 October; vault commits 379e3d7f172a and 200d08971937 (83 sources)

roles.name: claude-vault-app
roles.responsible: The vault's own app: index.html, .vault/app.json and app/ (reduced screenshots, manifest, versions), built from the PHP site's vault-app/.
roles.may: index.html, .vault/, app/ and a README section in the vault
roles.must_not: edit captures, source rows, claims or timeline
